But the signals against it are heavier. It is down 47% from the 30-minute return and 55% off its 30-minute high, so the bounce is a dip recovery in a coin that has mostly fallen. Sellers outnumber buyers in the recent window (117 vs. 100), and sell SOL (47.5) nearly matches buy SOL (55.2). The first two minutes after graduation show a sell-to-buy ratio above 1, and a launch bot was present. Pool depth of 62 SOL is thin relative to a $20 ticket plus the 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost.

Taken together, this looks like a post-graduation fade rather than durable demand. The 24% bounce is the kind of move that base rates say usually fails to hold over the next 30-60 minutes. I'd make no case for buying; skip.
